integrity: Analytic Fourier/Dirichlet proof plus independent hyperbolic-law-of-cosines numerical checks; simulation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n, curvature -1, independent arclength-uniform samples on one hyperbolic geodesic circle; mean area, not distribution or growing-n regimes. Historical priority and independent validation not established.
title: Finite polylogarithmic mean-area laws for random hyperbolic cyclic polygons
